newsitem.title: USA: Allied Capital Lending names Walton CEO.
newsitem.headline: Allied Capital Lending names Walton CEO.

text.p: Allied Capital Lending Corp said Friday it named Willliam L Walton chairman and chief executive officer.
Walton,47, replaces David Gladstone who stepped down as CEO and chairman on February 1, it said.
Walton, was also appointed chairman and chief executive of Allied Capital Advisers Inc, Allied Capital Lending's investment adviser, on February 3, it said.
Walton previously was managing director at New York-based Butler Capital Corp, was personal venture capital adviser for William Paley, founder of television network CBS.
Walton has been a director F Allied Capital Advisers Inc since 1986.
More recently, Walton has founded two private comnpanies with a focus on reading and languages dedicated to improving education for children.
Allied Capital Lending is a business development company. It makes loans to small, private businesses primarily through the Small Business Aministration's lending programs.
